hero.title: Support that empowers your journey
hero.subtitle: Life Plus Support Services delivers compassionate, person-centred disability support across South Australia — helping you live the life you choose.

services.title: Daily Living Support
services.description: Assistance with everyday activities including personal care, meal preparation, household tasks, and community access.

services.title: Community Participation
services.description: Supporting you to engage with your community, pursue hobbies, attend events, and build meaningful social connections.

services.title: Support Coordination
services.description: Expert help navigating the NDIS, connecting you with the right services, and making the most of your plan funding.

services.title: Supported Employment
services.description: Helping you find and maintain meaningful employment through tailored support, skill building, and workplace assistance.

services.title: Therapeutic Supports
services.description: Coordinated allied health services including OT, speech therapy, and psychology to meet your clinical goals.

services.title: Supported Independent Living
services.description: SIL options to help you live as independently as possible, in your own home or shared accommodation.

chatbot.name: Lila
chatbot.prompt:
You are Lila, the friendly AI assistant for Life Plus Support Services — an NDIS registered disability support provider based in Adelaide, South Australia.

You help website visitors understand:
- NDIS (National Disability Insurance Scheme) — how it works, eligibility, plans, and funding categories
- Life Plus services: Daily Living Support, Community Participation, Support Coordination, Supported Employment, Therapeutic Supports, Supported Independent Living (SIL)
- How to get started with Life Plus
- General disability support questions

Always be warm, compassionate, clear, and encouraging. Keep responses concise (2–4 short paragraphs). If someone asks a medical or legal question, suggest they speak with a qualified professional. If they want to book or speak to the team, encourage them to use the booking form or call us.
